mode.description: Input type. Hostname resolves the stored Atlas domain type; URL requires an explicit http:// or https:// scheme.

project_id.description: Optional visible Project scope for the exact lookup.

value.description: One hostname, IP address, or absolute HTTP(S) URL. Canonical values may not exceed 2,048 UTF-8 bytes.

probability.description: FIRST EPSS exploitation probability. This is not a complete risk score.

due_date.description: CISA BOD 22-01 federal directive context; this is not the Project's or operator's remediation SLA.

NdjsonStream.description: Newline-delimited RunStreamEvent objects. The first row is the line-event schema row; output rows include v=1 plus kind/role metadata, and idle streams may include heartbeat rows.

RunStreamEvent.description: Broker event object. Streams start with a schema row ({type=schema,event=schema,v=1,kind=line_event}); output and notice rows use the versioned line-event payload while preserving type and legacy cls for older clients. High-volume live streams may emit output_batch rows with a lines array of line events. Idle streams may emit type=heartbeat events.

WatcherDiffSummary.description: Bounded classifier summary for added, removed, and changed signals.

last_seen_at.description: Timestamp recorded for the current successful API authentication.

400.description: Invalid lookup value, type, or project scope
